p3.original: You might have heard about Keystone XL in the news. It was a pipeline system designed to bring oil from Canada to the refineries near the Gulf of Mexico, as well as to boost crude oil production in the United States. While a private company, TransCanada, planned to build and own the pipeline, U.S. government approval was required because of its size and location. There were four phases in plans to build the pipeline, and the first two of these had been in operation.
p3.zh: 你可能听说过新闻里的Keystone XL这是一种管道系统,旨在将加拿大的石油运至墨西哥湾附近的炼油厂,同时促进美国的原油生产。 虽然一家私营公司Trans Canada计划建造和拥有管道,但由于其规模和位置,需要美国政府批准。修建管道的计划分为四个阶段,其中前两个阶段已经投入使用。

p4.original: Sounds like a great idea, right? A pipeline that would move much needed crude oil to the Gulf refineries would increase oil production for manufacturing needs, reduce price pressure at the gas pump, and increase overall economic growth. Supporters argued that the pipeline would be one of the safest pipelines built yet, and would reduce America’s dependence on politically vulnerable Middle Eastern oil imports.
p4.zh: 听起来是个好主意,对吧?将急需的原油运往海湾炼油厂的管道将增加石油生产,满足制造需求,减少油泵的价格压力,并增加总体经济增长。支持者认为,该管道将是目前建造的最安全的管道之一,并将减少美国对政治上脆弱的中东石油进口的依赖。

p5.original: Not so fast, said its critics. The Keystone XL would be constructed over an enormous aquifer (one of the largest in the world) in the Midwest, and through an environmentally fragile area in Nebraska, causing great concern among environmentalists about possible destruction to the natural surroundings. They argued that leaks could taint valuable water sources and pipeline construction could disrupt and even harm indigenous species. Environmentalist groups fought government approval of the proposed pipeline construction, and in November 2015, the Obama administration refused to grant the cross-border permit necessary to build the Keystone XL pipeline. In 2017, the Trump administration sought to grant the necessary cross-border permit, and legal challenges emerged. In 2021, President Biden, on his first day in office, canceled the cross-border permit, effectively ending (for now) the Keystone XL pipeline.
p5.zh: 批评者说,不要这么快。地石XL将在中西部一个巨大的含水层(世界上最大的含水层之一)上建造,并穿过内布拉斯加州一个环境脆弱的地区,这引起了环保主义者对自然环境可能受到破坏的极大关切。 他们认为,漏水可能污染宝贵的水源,管道建设可能破坏甚至伤害土著物种。环保主义团体与政府对拟议管道建设的批斗,2015年11月,奥巴马政府拒绝发放建设Keystone XL管道所需的跨境许可.2017年,特朗普政府寻求给予必要的跨境许可,法律挑战出现.2021年,拜登总统在就职第一天取消了跨境许可,(目前)有效结束了(Keystone XL管道).

p6.original: Environmental concerns matter when discussing issues related to economic growth. However, how much should economists factor in these issues when deciding policy? In the case of the pipeline, how do we know how much damage it would cause when we do not know how to put a value on the environment? Would the pipeline's benefits outweigh the opportunity cost? The issue of how to balance economic progress with unintended effects on our planet is the subject of this chapter.
p6.zh: 在讨论与经济增长有关的问题时,环境关切很重要。 然而,经济学家在决定政策时应在多大程度上考虑这些问题? 就管道而言,当我们不知道如何给环境带来价值时,我们如何知道它会造成多大损害?管道的好处是否超过机会成本?如何平衡经济进步与对我们星球的意外影响的问题,是本章的主题。

p16.original: The problem of pollution arises for every economy in the world, whether high-income or low-income, and whether market-oriented or command-oriented. Every country needs to strike some balance between production and environmental quality. This chapter begins by discussing how firms may fail to take certain social costs, like pollution, into their planning if they do not need to pay these costs. Traditionally, policies for environmental protection have focused on governmental limits on how much of each pollutant could be emitted. While this approach has had some success, economists have suggested a range of more flexible, market-oriented policies that reduce pollution at a lower cost. We will consider both approaches, but first let’s see how economists frame and analyze these issues.
p16.zh: 污染问题出现在世界上的每一个经济体,无论是高收入还是低收入,以及市场导向还是指令导向。每个国家都需要在生产和环境质量之间取得某种平衡。本章首先讨论公司如果不需要支付某些社会成本,如污染,如何不将某些社会成本纳入其规划。传统上,环境保护政策的重点是政府限制每一种污染物的排放量。 虽然这种方法取得了一些成功,但经济学家建议了一系列更加灵活、面向市场的政策,以较低的成本减少污染。 我们将会考虑这两种方法,但首先让我们看看经济学家如何构建和分析这些问题。

Over this time period, carbon dioxide emissions from coal dropped 171 million metric tons (MMT) a year—a 66% reduction. p40.original: Despite the gradual reduction in emissions from fossil fuels, many important environmental issues remain. Along with the still high levels of air and water pollution, other issues include hazardous waste disposal, destruction of wetlands and other wildlife habitats, and the impact on human health from pollution.
p40.zh: 尽管矿物燃料的排放逐渐减少,但许多重要的环境问题依然存在。 除空气污染和水污染仍然严重外,其他问题包括危险废物处理、湿地和其他野生动物生境的破坏以及污染对人类健康的影响。

p42.original: Private markets, such as the cell phone industry, offer an efficient way to put buyers and sellers together and determine what goods they produce, how they produce them and who gets them. The principle that voluntary exchange benefits both buyers and sellers is a fundamental building block of the economic way of thinking. However, what happens when a voluntary exchange affects a third party who is neither the buyer nor the seller?
p42.zh: 私人市场,如手机业,为将买方和卖方聚集在一起,并确定他们生产何种商品、如何生产以及谁获得这些商品提供了有效的途径。自愿交换对买方和卖方都有好处的原则是经济思维方式的基本组成部分。 然而,如果自愿交换影响到第三方,而第三方既不是买方,也不是卖方,则会发生什么情况?

p43.original: As an example, consider a concert producer who wants to build an outdoor arena that will host country music concerts a half-mile from your neighborhood. You will be able to hear these outdoor concerts while sitting on your back porch—or perhaps even in your dining room. In this case, the sellers and buyers of concert tickets may both be quite satisfied with their voluntary exchange, but you have no voice in their market transaction. The effect of a market exchange on a third party who is outside or “external” to the exchange is called an externality. Because externalities that occur in market transactions affect other parties beyond those involved, they are sometimes called spillovers.
p43.zh: 以音乐会制作人为例, 希望建造一个户外竞技场, 举办乡村音乐会,坐在后门廊上, 甚至可能坐在餐厅里, 在这种情况下,演唱会门票的销售者和购买者可能都对其自愿交换感到相当满意,但你们在他们的市场交易中没有发言权.市场交易对交易所外部或“外部”第三方的影响称为外部性。 由于市场交易中发生的外部效应影响到所涉方以外的其他当事方,它们有时被称为外溢效应。

p44.original: Externalities can be negative or positive. If you hate country music, then having it waft into your house every night would be a negative externality. If you love country music, then what amounts to a series of free concerts would be a positive externality.
p44.zh: 外部性可以是负的,也可以是正的. 如果你讨厌乡村音乐,那么每晚都把乡村音乐卷进你家,就是一种负面的外在情绪. 如果你喜欢乡村音乐,那么相当于一系列免费音乐会的将是积极的外部性.

p45.zh: 污染作为一种消极的外部性

p81.original: However, as a by-product of the metals, plastics, chemicals and energy that refrigerator manufacturers use, some pollution is created. Let’s say that, if these pollutants were emitted into the air and water, they would create costs of $100 per refrigerator produced. These costs might occur because of adverse effects on human health, property values, or wildlife habitat, reduction of recreation possibilities, or because of other negative impacts. In a market with no anti-pollution restrictions, firms can dispose of certain wastes absolutely free. Now imagine that firms which produce refrigerators must factor in these external costs of pollution—that is, the firms have to consider not only labor and material costs, but also the broader costs to society of harm to health and other costs caused by pollution. If the firm is required to pay $100 for the additional external costs of pollution each time it produces a refrigerator, production becomes more costly and the entire supply curve shifts up by $100.
p81.zh: 然而,作为冰箱制造商使用的金属、塑料、化学品和能源的副产品,造成了一些污染。 如果这些污染物排放到空气和水中,这些费用可能是由于对人类健康、财产价值或野生生物栖息地的不利影响、娱乐可能性的减少,或者由于其他不利影响。在一个没有防止污染限制的市场中,公司可以完全自由地处置某些废物。 现在想象一下,生产冰箱的公司必须考虑到污染的这些外部成本,即,这些公司不仅必须考虑劳动力和物质成本,而且还必须考虑污染造成的健康损害对社会造成的更大成本和其他成本。 如果要求企业每次生产冰箱都要支付100美元的额外外部污染费用,则生产成本就会增加,整个供应曲线会上升100美元。

The new equilibrium will occur at E1. p114.original: Step 1. Determine the negative externality in this situation. To do this, you must think about the situation and consider all parties that might be impacted. A negative externality might be the increase in noise pollution in the area where the firm is playing.
p114.zh: 步骤1。确定这种情况的负面外在性。 要做到这一点,就必须考虑局势,并考虑可能受影响的各方。负面的外在因素可能是公司所在地区的噪音污染增加。

p115.original: Step 2. Identify the initial equilibrium price and quantity only taking private costs into account. Next, identify the new equilibrium taking into account social costs as well as private costs. Remember that equilibrium is where the quantity demanded is equal to the quantity supplied.
p115.zh: 步骤二.确定初始平衡价格和数量,只考虑私人成本。 其次,确定新的平衡,同时考虑到社会成本和私人成本。记住,要求的数量与提供的数量相等。

p116.original: Step 3. Look down the columns to where the quantity demanded (the second column) is equal to the “quantity supplied without paying the costs of the externality” (the third column). Then refer to the first column of that row to determine the equilibrium price. In this case, the equilibrium price and quantity would be at a price of $10 and a quantity of five when we only take into account private costs.
p116.zh: 步骤3。 从各栏看,要求的数量(第二栏)等于“不支付外部费用而提供的数量”(第三栏)。 然后参考该行第一栏来决定平衡价格. 在这种情况下,当我们只考虑私人费用时,平衡价格和数量将达到10美元和5美元。

p117.original: Step 4. Identify the equilibrium price and quantity when we take into account the additional external costs. Look down the columns of quantity demanded (the second column) and the “quantity supplied after paying the costs of the externality” (the fourth column) then refer to the first column of that row to determine the equilibrium price. In this case, the equilibrium will be at a price of $12 and a quantity of four.
p117.zh: 步骤4。 在我们考虑到额外的外部成本时,确定平衡价格和数量。将所需数量栏(第二栏)和“支付外部费用后提供的数量”栏(第四栏)下划,然后参照该栏第一栏确定平衡价格。 在这种情况下,平衡将以12美元和4美元的价格进行。

p118.original: Step 5. Consider how taking into account the externality affects the equilibrium price and quantity. Do this by comparing the two equilibrium situations. If the firm is forced to pay its additional external costs, then production of trumpet songs becomes more costly, and the supply curve will shift up.
p118.zh: 步骤5。考虑考虑外在性如何影响平衡价格和数量. 通过比较两种平衡情况来做到这一点。 如果公司被迫支付额外的外部成本,那么制作小号歌曲的成本就会增加,供应曲线会向上转移.

p119.original: Remember that the supply curve is based on choices about production that firms make while looking at their marginal costs, while the demand curve is based on the benefits that individuals perceive while maximizing utility. If no externalities existed, private costs would be the same as the costs to society as a whole, and private benefits would be the same as the benefits to society as a whole. Thus, if no externalities existed, the interaction of demand and supply will coordinate social costs and benefits.
p119.zh: 记住,供应曲线是基于企业在考虑其边际成本的同时做出的生产选择,而需求曲线则基于个人在最大限度发挥效用的同时所感受到的利益. 如果没有外部因素,私人成本与整个社会的成本相同,私人利益与整个社会的惠益相同。 因此,如果没有外部因素,供需的相互作用将协调社会成本和效益。

p120.original: However, when the externality of pollution exists, the supply curve no longer represents all social costs. Because externalities represent a case where markets no longer consider all social costs, but only some of them, economists commonly refer to externalities as an example of market failure. When there is market failure, the private market fails to achieve efficient output, because either firms do not account for all costs incurred in the production of output and/or consumers do not account for all benefits obtained (a positive externality). In the case of pollution, at the market output, social costs of production exceed social benefits to consumers, and the market produces too much of the product.
p120.zh: 然而,当污染的外部性存在时,供应曲线不再代表所有的社会成本. 由于外在因素代表了市场不再考虑所有社会成本,而只是考虑其中的一些成本,经济学家通常将外在因素称为市场失败的例子. 当市场失灵时,私营市场无法实现高效产出,因为要么公司不核算生产产出所产生的所有成本,或/或消费者不核算获得的所有利益(一种积极的外部性)。 在污染方面,按市场产出,生产的社会成本超过消费者的社会效益,市场生产的产品过多.

p121.original: We can see a general lesson here. If firms were required to pay the social costs of pollution, they would create less pollution but produce less of the product and charge a higher price. In the next module, we will explore how governments require firms to account for the social costs of pollution.
p121.zh: 我们在这里可以看到一个总的教训。 如果要求公司支付污染的社会成本,它们将减少污染,但生产的产品减少,并收取更高的价格。 在下一个单元中,我们将探讨政府如何要求公司对污染的社会成本负责。

p123.original: Economic production can cause environmental damage. This tradeoff arises for all countries, whether high-income or low-income, and whether their economies are market-oriented or command-oriented.
p123.zh: 经济生产可造成环境破坏. 这种取舍是所有国家的,无论是高收入还是低收入,以及其经济是面向市场还是面向指令的。

p124.original: An externality occurs when an exchange between a buyer and seller has an impact on a third party who is not part of the exchange. An externality, which is sometimes also called a spillover, can have a negative or a positive impact on the third party. If those parties imposing a negative externality on others had to account for the broader social cost of their behavior, they would have an incentive to reduce the production of whatever is causing the negative externality. In the case of a positive externality, the third party obtains benefits from the exchange between a buyer and a seller, but they are not paying for these benefits. If this is the case, then markets would tend to under produce output because suppliers are not aware of the additional demand from others. If the parties generating benefits to others would somehow receive compensation for these external benefits, they would have an incentive to increase production of whatever is causing the positive externality. In either case, because resources are not being allocated efficiently, the externality leads to market failure.
p124.zh: 当买卖双方的交换对不属于交换范围的第三方产生影响时,即为外部性。外部性,有时也被称为外溢性,可对第三方产生负面或正面影响. 如果那些将负面的外部性强加于他人的当事方必须为其行为造成的更广泛的社会成本负责,那么它们就会有动力减少造成负面外部性的任何因素的生产。 在积极的外部性情况下,第三方从买方与卖方之间的交换中获得利益,但他们不支付这些利益。 如果是这样,那么市场往往会因为供应商不知道其他供应商的额外需求而降低产出。 如果给他人带来好处的当事方会以某种方式获得这些外部好处的补偿,它们就会有动力增加生产任何引起积极外部作用的东西。无论是哪种情况,由于资源没有得到高效分配,外部性导致市场失灵。

p211.original: When the United States started passing comprehensive environmental laws in the late 1960s and early 1970s, a typical law specified to companies how much pollution their smokestacks or drainpipes could emit and imposed penalties if companies exceeded the limit. Other laws required that companies install certain equipment—for example, on automobile tailpipes or on smokestacks—to reduce pollution. These types of laws, which specify allowable quantities of pollution and which also may detail which pollution-control technologies companies must use, fall under the category of command-and-control regulation. In effect, command-and-control regulation requires that firms increase their costs by installing anti-pollution equipment. Thus, firms are required to account for the social costs of pollution in deciding how much output to produce.
p211.zh: 当美国于1960年代末和1970年代初开始通过全面的环境法时,一项典型的法律具体规定,公司在超过限额时其烟囱或排水管可产生多大程度的污染,并处以罚款。另一些法律要求公司安装某些设备,例如汽车尾管或烟雾袋,以减少污染。 这些类型的法律规定了允许的污染数量,并可能详细规定了控制污染技术公司必须使用哪些技术,属于指挥和控制条例的范畴。 实际上,指挥和控制条例要求公司通过安装防污染设备来增加成本。 因此,要求公司在决定生产多少产出时,要考虑污染的社会成本。

p212.original: Command-and-control regulation has been highly successful in protecting and cleaning up the U.S. environment. In 1970, the  Federal government created the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) to oversee all environmental laws. In the same year, Congress enacted the Clean Air Act to address air pollution. Just two years later, in 1972, Congress passed and the president signed the far-reaching Clean Water Act. These command-and-control environmental laws, and their amendments and updates, have been largely responsible for America’s cleaner air and water in recent decades. However, economists have pointed out three difficulties with command-and-control environmental regulation.
p212.zh: 指挥与控制监管在保护和清理美国环境方面非常成功.1970年,联邦政府成立了环境保护局(EPA),负责监督所有环境法. 同年,国会颁布了"清洁空气法案"以解决空气污染问题.仅仅两年后的1972年,国会通过,总统签署了影响深远的"清洁水法".近几十年来,这些指挥和控制环境法律及其修正和更新在很大程度上对美国清洁空气和水负有责任。 然而,经济学家指出,在指挥和控制环境监管方面存在三个困难。

p213.original: First, command-and-control regulation offers no incentive to improve the quality of the environment beyond the standard set by a particular law. Once firms meet the standard, polluters have zero incentive to do better.
p213.zh: 第一,指挥与控制条例没有为超出特定法律规定的标准而改善环境质量提供动力。 一旦企业达到标准,污染者就没有动力做更好的工作。

p214.original: Second, command-and-control regulation is inflexible. It usually requires the same standard for all polluters, and often the same pollution-control technology as well. This means that command-and-control regulation draws no distinctions between firms that would find it easy and inexpensive to meet the pollution standard—or to reduce pollution even further—and firms that might find it difficult and costly to meet the standard. Firms have no reason to rethink their production methods in fundamental ways that might reduce pollution even more and at lower cost.
p214.zh: 二,指挥控制规范不灵活. 它通常要求所有污染者采用同样的标准,而且往往也要求同样的污染控制技术。 这意味着,指挥和控制条例并不区分那些认为达到污染标准(或进一步减少污染)容易和便宜的公司,以及那些认为达到标准可能困难和代价高昂的公司。公司没有理由以可能减少污染、降低成本的基本方式重新考虑其生产方法。

p215.original: Third, legislators and EPA analysts write the command-and-control regulations, and so they are subject to compromises in the political process. Existing firms often argue (and lobby) that stricter environmental standards should not apply to them, only to new firms that wish to start production. Consequently, real-world environmental laws are full of fine print, loopholes, and exceptions.
p215.zh: 第三,立法者和环保局分析员制定指挥与控制条例,因此,他们在政治进程中受到妥协。现有公司往往认为(和游说),更严格的环境标准不应适用于它们,而应只适用于希望开始生产的新公司。 因此,现实世界的环境法充斥着精细的印刷品、漏洞和例外。

p216.original: Although critics accept the goal of reducing pollution, they question whether command-and-control regulation is the best way to design policy tools for accomplishing that goal. A different approach is the use of market-oriented tools, which we discussed in the next section.
p216.zh: 虽然批评者接受减少污染的目标,但他们质疑指挥和控制管制是否是设计实现该目标的政策工具的最佳途径。另一种方法是使用面向市场的工具,我们在下一节中讨论了这个问题。

p218.original: Command-and-control regulation sets specific limits for pollution emissions and/or specific pollution-control technologies that firms must use. Although such regulations have helped to protect the environment, they have three shortcomings: they provide no incentive for going beyond the limits they set; they offer limited flexibility on where and how to reduce pollution; and they often have politically-motivated loopholes.
p218.zh: 指挥和控制条例对污染排放和/或企业必须使用的具体污染控制技术规定了具体限制。 虽然这些条例有助于保护环境,但有三种缺点:它们没有为超越它们规定的限度提供动力;它们在减少污染的地点和方式方面的灵活性有限;它们往往有出于政治动机的漏洞。

p220.original: Consider two approaches to reducing emissions of CO2 into the environment from manufacturing industries in the United States. In the first approach, the U.S. government makes it a policy to use only predetermined technologies. In the second approach, the U.S. government determines which technologies are cleaner and subsidizes their use. Of the two approaches, which is the command-and-control policy?
p220.zh: 考虑采取两种办法,减少美国制造业向环境中排放二氧化碳。 在第一种方法中,美国政府将只使用预先确定的技术作为一项政策. 在第二种方法中,美国政府确定哪些技术比较清洁,并补贴其使用. 在这两种办法中,哪一种是指挥和控制政策?

p221.original: The first policy is command-and-control because it is a requirement that applies to all producers.
p221.zh: 第一个政策是指挥与控制,因为它是适用于所有生产者的一项要求。

p223.zh: 什么是指挥和控制环境条例?

p224.original: What are the three problems that economists have noted with regard to command-and-control regulation?
p224.zh: 经济学家在指挥与控制监管方面注意到的三个问题是什么?

p226.original: Would environmentalists favor command-and-control policies as a way to reduce pollution? Why or why not?
p226.zh: 环保人士是否赞成将指挥和控制政策作为减少污染的途径? 为什么或为什么不呢?

p227.original: Consider two ways of protecting elephants from poachers in African countries. In one approach, the government sets up enormous national parks that have sufficient habitat for elephants to thrive and forbids all local people to enter the parks or to injure either the elephants or their habitat in any way. In a second approach, the government sets up national parks and designates 10 villages around the edges of the park as official tourist centers that become places where tourists can stay and bases for guided tours inside the national park. Consider the different incentives of local villagers—who often are living in poverty—in each of these plans. Which plan seems more likely to help the elephant population?
p227.zh: 考虑两种方法保护大象免受非洲国家偷猎者的伤害. 政府建立了庞大的国家公园, 有足够的栖息地让大象繁衍起来, 禁止所有当地民众进入公园,第二种方式是,政府设立国家公园,指定公园边缘周围的10个村庄为官方旅游中心,成为游客可以停留的地方和国家公园内导游的基地.在每个计划中考虑当地村民——他们常常生活在贫困之中——的不同激励因素。哪个计划更可能帮助大象种群?

p229.original: Market-oriented environmental policies create incentives to allow firms some flexibility in reducing pollution. The three main categories of market-oriented approaches to pollution control are pollution charges, marketable permits, and better-defined property rights. All of these policy tools which we discuss, below, address the shortcomings of command-and-control regulation—albeit in different ways.
p229.zh: 以市场为导向的环境政策创造了鼓励措施,使公司在减少污染方面有一定的灵活性。以市场为导向的污染控制方法主要分为三类,即污染收费、可销售许可证和定义更明确的产权。 下文我们讨论的所有这些政策工具都涉及指挥和控制条例的缺点——尽管其方式不同。

p231.original: A pollution charge is a tax imposed on the quantity of pollution that a firm emits. A pollution charge gives a profit-maximizing firm an incentive to determine ways to reduce its emissions—as long as the marginal cost of reducing the emissions is less than the tax.
p231.zh: 污染费是对企业排放的污染数量征收的税。污染费使利润最大化的公司能够确定减少排放的方法——只要减少排放的边际成本低于税收。

p232.original: For example, consider a small firm that emits 50 pounds per year of small particles, such as soot, into the air. This particulate matter causes respiratory illnesses and also imposes costs on firms and individuals.
p232.zh: 例如,考虑一个小公司,每年向空气中喷出50磅的烟尘等小颗粒。 这种微粒物质导致呼吸道疾病,也给公司和个人造成费用。

p233.original: illustrates the marginal costs that a firm faces in reducing pollution. The marginal cost of pollution reduction, like most marginal cost curves, increases with output, at least in the short run. Reducing the first 10 pounds of particulate emissions costs the firm $300. Reducing the second 10 pounds would cost $500; reducing the third ten pounds would cost $900; reducing the fourth 10 pounds would cost $1,500; and the fifth 10 pounds would cost $2,500. This pattern for the costs of reducing pollution is common, because the firm can use the cheapest and easiest method to make initial reductions in pollution, but additional reductions in pollution become more expensive.
p233.zh: 说明企业在减少污染方面面临的边际成本。与大多数边际成本曲线一样,减少污染的边际成本随着产出而增加,至少在短期内是这样.减少头10磅的颗粒排放,公司要花费300美元。减少第二个10磅将花费500美元;减少第三个10磅将花费900美元;减少第四个10磅将花费1500美元;第五个10磅将花费2500美元. 这种减少污染成本的模式很常见,因为公司可以使用最便宜和最简便的方法来初步减少污染,但进一步减少污染的费用会增加。

p235.original: Imagine the firm now faces a pollution tax of $1,000 for every 10 pounds of particulates it emits. The firm has the choice of either polluting and paying the tax, or reducing the amount of particulates it emits and paying the cost of abatement as the figure shows. How much will the firm pollute and how much will the firm abate? The first 10 pounds would cost the firm $300 to abate. This is substantially less than the $1,000 tax, so the firm will choose to abate. The second 10 pounds would cost $500 to abate, which is still less than the tax, so it will choose to abate. The third 10 pounds would cost $900 to abate, which is slightly less than the $1,000 tax. The fourth 10 pounds would cost $1,500, which is much more costly than paying the tax. As a result, the firm will decide to reduce pollutants by 30 pounds, because the marginal cost of reducing pollution by this amount is less than the pollution tax. With a tax of $1,000, the firm has no incentive to reduce pollution more than 30 pounds.
p235.zh: 想象一下,公司现在面临污染税 每10磅颗粒,1 000美元。 如图所示,公司可以选择污染和缴纳税款,或减少其排放的微粒量,并支付减排费用。律所会污染多少,律所会减少多少?头10磅会让公司损失300美元来减肥. 这大大低于1000美元的税收,因此公司会选择减税.后十斤,减五百,仍减税,故选减.第三个10磅将花费900美元来减税,这略低于1000美元的税收.第四个10磅将花费1500美元,这比缴纳税款要昂贵得多. 因此,公司会决定将污染物减少30磅,因为减少污染的边际成本低于污染税.以1000元的税收,公司没有减少30磅以上的污染的积极性.

p236.original: A firm that has to pay a pollution tax will have an incentive to figure out the least expensive technologies for reducing pollution. Firms that can reduce pollution cheaply and easily will do so to minimize their pollution taxes; whereas firms that will incur high costs for reducing pollution will end up paying the pollution tax instead. If the pollution tax applies to every source of pollution, then there are no special favoritism or loopholes for politically well-connected producers.
p236.zh: 一家必须缴纳污染税的公司,将鼓励找出最廉价的减少污染技术。能够廉价和轻易地减少污染的企业将这样做,以尽量减少其污染税;而为减少污染而付出高昂代价的企业则最终会支付污染税。 如果污染税适用于所有污染源,那么对于政治上联系密切的生产者来说,就没有特殊的优惠或漏洞.

p237.original: For an example of a pollution charge at the household level, consider two ways of charging for garbage collection. One method is to have a flat fee per household, no matter how much garbage a household produces. An alternative approach is to have several levels of fees, depending on how much garbage the household produces—and to offer lower or free charges for recyclable materials. As of 2006 (latest statistics available), the EPA had recorded over 7,000 communities that have implemented “pay as you throw” programs. When people have a financial incentive to put out less garbage and to increase recycling, they find ways to make it happen.
p237.zh: 以家庭一级污染收费为例,考虑对垃圾收集征收两种收费方式.一种方法是,无论一个家庭产生多少垃圾,每个家庭都收取固定费用。另一种办法是,根据家庭生产的垃圾数量确定若干收费水平,并对可回收材料提供较低或免费的收费。 截至2006年(现有最新统计数据),环保局已记录了7 000多个社区实施了“随你便付费”方案。 当人们有财政刺激,要少放垃圾,增加回收利用时,他们就会找到实现的方法.

p238.original: A number of environmental policies are really pollution charges, although they often do not travel under that name. For example, the federal government and many state governments impose taxes on gasoline. We can view this tax as a charge on the air pollution that cars generate as well as a source of funding for maintaining roads. Gasoline taxes are far higher in most other countries than in the United States.
p238.zh: 一些环境政策实际上是污染费,尽管它们往往不以这一名称旅行。 例如,联邦政府和许多州政府对汽油征税. 我们可以将这项税视为对汽车产生的空气污染的收费,以及维修道路的资金来源。 其他大多数国家的汽油税远高于美国.

p239.original: Similarly, the refundable charge of five or 10 cents that only 10 states have for returning recyclable cans and bottles works like a pollution tax that provides an incentive to avoid littering or throwing bottles in the trash. Compared with command-and-control regulation, a pollution tax reduces pollution in a more flexible and cost-effective way.
p239.zh: 同样,只有10个州有5或10美分可回收罐和瓶子的退款,其作用类似污染税,它为避免垃圾中丢弃或扔瓶子提供了奖励。与指挥与控制条例相比,污染税以更灵活和更具成本效益的方式减少污染。

p240.original: Visit this website to see the current U.S. states with bottle bills and the states that have active campaigns for new bottle bills. You can also view current and proposed bills in Canada and other countries around the world.
p240.zh: 访问这个网站,看看目前美国各邦的瓶子账单,以及那些积极开展新瓶子账单运动的各州.也可在加拿大及全球其他国家查看当前及拟议法案。

p242.original: When a city or state government sets up a marketable permit program  (e.g., cap-and-trade), it must start by determining the overall quantity of pollution it will allow as it tries to meet national pollution standards. Then, it divides a number of permits allowing only this quantity of pollution among the firms that emit that pollutant. The government can sell or provide these permits to pollute free to firms.
p242.zh: 城市或州政府制定市场化许可方案(例如,上限和交易)时,必须首先确定在试图达到国家污染标准时允许的污染总量。 然后,它将若干许可证分成只允许排放这种污染物的公司遭受这种污染的数量。 政府可以出售或提供这些许可证,免费污染公司。

p243.original: Now, add two more conditions. Imagine that these permits are designed to reduce total emissions over time. For example, a permit may allow emission of 10 units of pollution one year, but only nine units the next year, then eight units the year after that, and so on down to some lower level. In addition, imagine that these are marketable permits, meaning that firms can buy and sell them.
p243.zh: 现在,增加两个条件。想象一下,这些许可证旨在逐步减少排放总量。 例如,许可证可能允许一年排放10个污染单位,但次年仅排放9个污染单位,之后的一年再排放8个污染单位,等等,其排放水平会降低到一些较低的水平. 此外,想象这些是可销售的许可证,意味着公司可以买卖这些许可证。

p244.original: To see how marketable permits can work to reduce pollution, consider the four firms in . The table shows current emissions of lead from each firm. At the start of the marketable permit program, each firm receives permits to allow this level of pollution. However, these permits are shrinkable, and next year the permits allow the firms to emit only half as much pollution. Let’s say that in a year, Firm Gamma finds it easy and cheap to reduce emissions from 600 tons of lead to 200 tons, which means that it has permits that it is not using that allow emitting 100 tons of lead. Firm Beta reduces its lead pollution from 400 tons to 200 tons, so it does not need to buy any permits, and it does not have any extra permits to sell. However, although Firm Alpha can easily reduce pollution from 200 tons to 150 tons, it finds that it is cheaper to purchase permits from Gamma rather than to reduce its own emissions to 100. Meanwhile, Firm Delta did not even exist in the first period, so the only way it can start production is to purchase permits to emit 50 tons of lead.
p244.zh: 为了了解可销售许可证如何能够减少污染,请考虑其中的四家公司。 该表显示各公司铅的当前排放量。 在可销售许可证方案开始时,每个公司都获得允许这种程度的污染的许可证。 然而,这些许可证是可以缩减的,明年许可证允许公司排放的污染量只有一半。换句话说,在一年之内,Gamma公司发现把600吨铅的排放减少至200吨是容易和便宜的,这意味着它允许它不使用100吨铅。公司Beta将其铅污染从400吨减少到200吨,因此不需要购买任何许可证,也没有额外的许可证出售. 然而,尽管Firm Alpha公司可以轻易地将污染从200吨减少到150吨,但它发现从Gamma公司购买许可证比将自己的排放量减少到100个更便宜。 同时,Firm Delta在第一个时期甚至不存在,所以它开始生产的唯一办法是购买许可证以排放50吨铅.

p245.original: The total quantity of pollution will decline. However, buying and selling the marketable permits will determine exactly which firms reduce pollution and by how much. With a system of marketable permits, the firms that find it least expensive to do so will reduce pollution the most.
p245.zh: 污染总量将下降。 然而,买卖可销售的许可证将确切决定哪些公司减少污染,以及减少污染的数额。有了市场许可制度,认为这样做成本最低的公司将最大幅度地减少污染。

p252.original: Current emissions—permits distributed free for this amount
p252.zh: 目前的排放——免费发放的许可证

p257.original: How much pollution will these permits allow in one year?

p262.original: Actual emissions one year in the future
p262.zh: 未来一年的实际排放量

p267.original: Buyer or seller of marketable permit?

p272.original: Another application of marketable permits occurred when the U.S. government amended the Clean Air Act in 1990. The revised law sought to reduce sulfur dioxide emissions from electric power plants to half of the 1980 levels out of concern that sulfur dioxide was causing acid rain, which harms forests as well as buildings. In this case, the marketable permits the federal government issued were free of charge (no pun intended) to electricity-generating plants across the country, especially those that were burning coal (which produces sulfur dioxide). These permits were of the “shrinkable” type; that is, the amount of pollution allowed by a given permit declined with time.
p272.zh: 1990年美国政府修改"清洁空气法"时,又出现了可销售许可证的另一种应用.修订后的法律试图将发电厂的二氧化硫排放量减少到1980年水平的一半,因为人们担心二氧化硫正在造成酸雨,从而损害森林和建筑物。 在这种情况下,联邦政府向全国各地的发电厂,特别是燃烧煤(产生二氧化硫)的发电厂免费发放可销售许可证(无双关语意向)。 这些许可证属于“可缩”类型,即某一许可证允许的污染量随时间而减少。

p274.original: A clarified and strengthened idea of property rights can also strike a balance between economic activity and pollution. Ronald Coase (1910–2013), who won the 1991 Nobel Prize in economics, offered a vivid illustration of an externality: a railroad track running beside a farmer’s field where the railroad locomotive sometimes emits sparks and sets the field ablaze. Coase asked whose responsibility it was to address this spillover. Should the farmer be required to build a tall fence alongside the field to block the sparks, or should the railroad be required to place a gadget on the locomotive’s smokestack to reduce the number of sparks?
p274.zh: 明确和加强财产权的概念也可以在经济活动和污染之间取得平衡。 罗纳德·科斯(1910年-2013年)曾获得1991年诺贝尔经济学奖,他生动地说明了一种外在性:一条铁路轨道运行在农民田边,铁路机车有时会喷出火花并点燃田野。Coase询问谁有责任解决这一外溢问题。是否应该要求农民在田间边建高高的栅栏来挡住火花,还是应该要求铁路在机车的烟台上放置一个装置以减少火花的数量?

p275.original: Coase pointed out that one cannot resolve this issue until one clearly defines property rights—that is, the legal rights of ownership on which others are not allowed to infringe without paying compensation. Does the farmer have a property right not to have a field burned? Does the railroad have a property right to run its own trains on its own tracks? If neither party has a property right, then the two sides may squabble endlessly, doing nothing, and sparks will continue to set the field aflame. However, if either the farmer or the railroad has a well-defined legal responsibility, then that party will seek out and pay for the least costly method of reducing the risk that sparks will hit the field. The property right determines whether the farmer or the railroad pays the bills.
p275.zh: Coase指出,在明确界定财产权之前,即不允许他人在不支付赔偿的情况下侵犯所有权的法律权利,不能解决这一问题。农民是否拥有不烧田的财产权?.铁路是否拥有在自己的轨道上自行运行列车的财产权?. 如果任何一方都没有财产权,那么双方可能会无休止地争吵,无所事事,火花会继续点燃田野的火焰. 然而,如果农民或铁路有明确的法律责任,则该方将寻求并支付费用最低的方法,以减少火花会击中田地的风险。财产权决定是农民还是铁路支付账单。

p276.original: The property rights approach is highly relevant in cases involving endangered species. The U.S. government’s endangered species list includes about 1,000 plants and animals, and about 90% of these species live on privately owned land. The protection of these endangered species requires careful thinking about incentives and property rights. The discovery of an endangered species on private land has often triggered an automatic reaction from the government to prohibit the landowner from using that land for any purpose that might disturb the imperiled creatures. Consider the incentives of that policy: If you admit to the government that you have an endangered species, the government effectively prohibits you from using your land. As a result, rumors abounded of landowners who followed a policy of “shoot, shovel, and shut up” when they found an endangered animal on their land. Other landowners have deliberately cut trees or managed land in a way that they knew would discourage endangered animals from locating there.
p276.zh: 产权办法在涉及濒危物种的案件中具有高度相关性。美国政府的濒危物种列表包括约1000种动植物,其中约90%的物种生活在私有土地上.保护这些濒危物种需要仔细考虑奖励和财产权。 在私人土地上发现濒危物种,往往引发政府自动作出反应,禁止土地所有者将土地用于任何可能扰乱濒危生物的目的。想想这个政策的动机:如果你向政府承认你有一个濒危物种,政府实际上禁止你使用你的土地. 结果,传闻充斥着土地所有者,当他们在自己的土地上发现一只濒危动物时,他们奉行“射击、铲铲和闭嘴”的政策。 其他土地所有者故意砍伐树木或管理土地,他们知道这样做会阻止濒危动物找到那里。

p277.original: How effective are market-oriented environmental policy tools?
p277.zh: 面向市场的环境政策工具是否有效?

p278.original: Environmentalists sometimes fear that market-oriented environmental tools are an excuse to weaken or eliminate strict limits on pollution emissions and instead to allow more pollution. It is true that if pollution charges are set very low or if marketable permits do not reduce pollution by very much then market-oriented tools will not work well. However, command-and-control environmental laws can also be full of loopholes or have exemptions that do not reduce pollution by much, either. The advantage of market-oriented environmental tools is not that they reduce pollution by more or less, but because of their incentives and flexibility, they can achieve any desired reduction in pollution at a lower cost to society.
p278.zh: 环保主义者有时担心,面向市场的环境工具是削弱或消除对污染排放的严格限制的借口,相反,是允许更多的污染。诚然,如果污染费定得很低,或者如果可销售许可证不能用非常多的方式减少污染,那么面向市场的工具就不会奏效。 然而,指挥和控制环境法也可能充满漏洞,或具有不会减少太多污染的豁免。以市场为导向的环境工具的优点不是它们能减少多少污染,而是因为它们的激励和灵活性,它们能够以较低的社会成本实现任何期望的减少污染.

p279.original: A more productive policy would consider how to provide private landowners with an incentive to protect the endangered species that they find and to provide a habitat for additional endangered species. For example, the government might pay landowners who provide and maintain suitable habitats for endangered species or who restrict the use of their land to protect an endangered species. Again, an environmental law built on incentives and flexibility offers greater promise than a command-and-control approach when trying to oversee millions of acres of privately owned land.
p279.zh: 一项更有成效的政策将考虑如何鼓励私人土地所有者保护他们发现的濒危物种,并为其他濒危物种提供栖息地。 例如,政府可能向为濒危物种提供和维持适当生境的地主支付费用,或向限制使用其土地保护濒危物种的地主支付费用。 同样,在试图监督数百万英亩私有土地时,建立在激励和灵活性基础上的环境法比指挥和控制方法更有希望。

p280.zh: 应用面向市场的环境工具

p281.original: Market-oriented environmental policies are a tool kit. Specific policy tools will work better in some situations than in others. For example, marketable permits work best when a few dozen or a few hundred parties are highly interested in trading, as in the cases of oil refineries that trade lead permits or electrical utilities that trade sulfur dioxide permits. However, for cases in which millions of users emit small amounts of pollution—such as emissions from car engines or unrecycled soda cans—and have no strong interest in trading, pollution charges will typically offer a better choice. We can also combine market-oriented environmental tools. We can view marketable permits as a form of improved property rights. Alternatively, the government could combine marketable permits with a pollution tax on any emissions not covered by a permit.
p281.zh: 面向市场的环境政策是一个工具箱。特定的政策工具在某些情况下比在另一些情况下更能发挥作用。 例如,在几十个或几百个对贸易非常感兴趣的当事方中,可销售的允许工作最为有效,例如贸易铅的炼油厂或交易二氧化硫许可的电力公司。 然而,对于数百万用户排放少量污染(例如汽车发动机的排放或未回收的汽水罐),而且对交易没有强烈兴趣的情况,污染收费一般会提供更好的选择。 我们还可以把面向市场的环境工具结合起来。 我们可以将可销售的许可证视为一种改善产权的形式。 或者,政府可以将可销售许可证与对许可证未涵盖的任何排放征收的污染税结合起来。

p283.original: Examples of market-oriented environmental policies, also called cap and trade programs, include pollution charges, marketable permits, and better-defined property rights. Market-oriented environmental policies include taxes, markets, and property rights so that those who impose negative externalities must face the social cost.
p283.zh: 以市场为导向的环境政策的例子,也称为上限和贸易方案,包括污染费、可销售许可证以及更明确的财产权。面向市场的环境政策包括税收、市场和产权,这样那些强加负面外在因素的人就必须面对社会代价。

p401.original: The Benefits and Costs of U.S. Environmental Laws

p402.zh: 政府经济学家估计,美国公司可能每年支付超过2000亿美元,以遵守联邦环境法. 这是一笔巨大的钱。钱花得漂亮吗?

p403.original: Benefits and Costs of Clean Air and Clean Water
p403.zh: 清洁空气和清洁水的益处和成本

p404.original: We can divide the benefits of a cleaner environment into four areas: (1) people may stay healthier and live longer; (2) certain industries that rely on clean air and water, such as farming, fishing, and tourism, may benefit; (3) property values may be higher; and (4) people may simply enjoy a cleaner environment in a way that does not need to involve a market transaction. Some of these benefits, such as gains to tourism or farming, are relatively easy to value in economic terms. It is harder to assign a monetary value to others, such as the value of clean air for someone with asthma. It seems difficult to put a clear-cut monetary value on still others, such as the satisfaction you might feel from knowing that the air is clear over the Grand Canyon, even if you have never visited the Grand Canyon, but advanced techniques in economics allow one to generate estimates.
p404.zh: 我们可以将清洁环境的好处分为四个方面:(1)人们可能保持健康,活得更长;(2)某些依赖清洁空气和水的行业,如农耕,渔业,旅游业,可能受益;(3)财产价值可能更高;(4)人们可能简单地享受清洁环境,其方式不需要涉及市场交易.其中一些好处,如旅游业或农业收益,在经济方面比较容易得到重视。更难为他人分配金钱价值,如对哮喘患者来说清洁空气的价值.似乎很难把明确的货币价值放在其他的身上, 比如你可能从了解大峡谷上空的空气是清澈的感到的满意, 即使你从未去过大峡谷,但是经济学的先进技术允许人们产生估计数。

p405.original: Although estimates of environmental benefits are not precise, they can still be revealing. For example, a study by the Environmental Protection Agency looked at the costs and benefits of the Clean Air Act from 1970 to 1990. It found that total costs over that time period were roughly $500 billion—a huge amount. However, it also found that a middle-range estimate of the health and other benefits from cleaner air was $22 trillion—about 44 times higher than the costs. A more recent EPA study estimated that the environmental benefits to Americans from the Clean Air Act will exceed their costs by a margin of four to one. The EPA estimated that “in 2010 the benefits of Clean Air Act programs will total about $110 billion. This estimate represents the value of avoiding increases in illness and premature death which would have prevailed.” Saying that overall benefits of environmental regulation have exceeded costs in the past, however, is very different from saying that every environmental regulation makes sense. For example, studies suggest that when breaking down emission reductions by type of contaminants, the benefits of air pollution control outweigh the costs primarily for particulates and lead, but when looking at other air pollutants, the costs of reducing them may be comparable to or greater than the benefits. Just because some environmental regulations have had benefits much higher than costs does not prove that every individual regulation is a sensible idea.
p405.zh: 虽然对环境效益的估计并不准确,但仍然可以揭示出来。 例如,环境保护局的一项研究研究了1970年至1990年《清洁空气法》的成本和效益。调查发现,这一期间的总费用大约为5 000亿美元,数额巨大。 然而,委员会还发现,对清洁空气的健康和其他好处的中程估计是22万亿美元,比成本高出44倍。 最近一项环保局的研究估计,《清洁空气法》给美国人带来的环境惠益将超过其成本4:1的比值。环保局估计,“2010年,清洁空气法方案的好处总额约为1 100亿美元。 这一估计代表了避免疾病和过早死亡增加的价值,本来是普遍存在的。” 但是,说环境条例的总体效益在过去已经超过成本,与说每一项环境条例都是有意义的大不相同。 例如,研究表明,在按污染物类型分列排减量时,空气污染控制的好处大于主要用于微粒和铅的成本,但在研究其他空气污染物时,减少这些污染物的成本可能与效益相当或更大。仅仅因为一些环境条例的好处远高于成本,并不能证明每一项条例都是明智的构想。

p406.zh: 生态旅游:使环境观得到回报

p407.original: The definition of ecotourism is a little vague. Does it mean sleeping on the ground, eating roots, and getting close to wild animals? Does it mean flying in a helicopter to shoot anesthetic darts at African wildlife, or a little of both? The definition may be fuzzy, but tourists who hope to appreciate the ecology of their destination—“eco tourists”—are the impetus to a big and growing business. The International Ecotourism Society estimates that international tourists interested in seeing nature or wildlife would take 1.56 billion trips by 2020. While COVID-19 prevented this from happening in 2020, it is clear that there is a strong demand for ecotourism.
p407.zh: 生态旅游的定义有些模糊.谓 睡在地上,吃根,与野生动物相亲?意思是搭直升机 在非洲野生动物身上射麻醉镖 还是两者都有?定义可能模糊不清,但希望欣赏目的地生态的游客—— " 生态游客 " ——是大型和不断发展的企业的动力。 国际生态旅游协会估计,有兴趣观赏自然或野生动物的国际游客到2020年将乘坐15.6亿次旅游. 虽然COVID-19在2020年阻止了这种情况的发生,但生态旅游的需求显然很大。

p408.original: Visit The International Ecotourism Society’s website to learn more about The International Ecotourism Society, its programs, and tourism’s role in sustainable community development.
p408.zh: 访问国际生态旅游协会的网站,了解更多关于国际生态旅游协会、其方案以及旅游业在可持续社区发展中的作用。

p409.original: Realizing the attraction of ecotourism, the residents of low-income countries may come to see that preserving wildlife habitats is more lucrative than, say, cutting down forests or grazing livestock. In South Africa, Namibia, and Zimbabwe, for example, ecotourism has given local communities an economic interest in protecting elephant and rhinoceros populations. Some of the leading ecotourism destinations include Costa Rica and Panama in Central America; the Caribbean; Malaysia, and other South Pacific destinations; New Zealand; the Serengeti in Tanzania; the Amazon rain forests; and the Galapagos Islands. In many of these countries and regions, governments have enacted policies whereby they share revenues from ecotourism with local communities, to give people in those local communities a kind of property right that encourages them to conserve their local environment.
p409.zh: 低收入国家居民认识到生态旅游的吸引力,他们可能发现,保护野生动物生境比砍伐森林或放牧牲畜更有利可图。 例如,在南非、纳米比亚和津巴布韦,生态旅游使当地社区在保护大象和犀牛人口方面具有经济利益。 一些主要的生态旅游目的地包括中美洲的哥斯达黎加和巴拿马;加勒比;马来西亚和其他南太平洋的目的地;新西兰;坦桑尼亚的塞伦盖蒂;亚马逊雨林;加拉帕戈斯群岛。 在这些国家和地区中,许多国家的政府颁布了政策,根据这些政策,它们与当地社区分享生态旅游收入,给予这些地方社区的人民一种财产权,鼓励他们保护当地环境。

p410.original: Ecotourism needs careful management, so that the combination of eager tourists and local entrepreneurs does not destroy what the visitors are coming to see. And recent research indicates that wild animals that are continually exposed to tourists and vehicles exhibit stress and atypical behaviors. In general, however, well-managed ecotourism is viewed as a net positive, which provides an alternative to damaging the local environment.
p410.zh: 生态旅游需要认真管理,这样热心的游客和当地企业家的结合,就不会破坏游客前来观看的东西. 最近的研究显示,不断暴露在游客和车辆身上的野生动物表现出压力和非典型的行为. 然而,总的来说,管理良好的生态旅游被视为一种净积极因素,它为破坏当地环境提供了一种替代办法。

p412.original: We can use the tools of marginal analysis to illustrate the marginal costs and the marginal benefits of reducing pollution.   illustrates a theoretical model of this situation. When the quantity of environmental protection is low so that pollution is extensive—for example, at quantity Qa—there are usually numerous relatively cheap and easy ways to reduce pollution, and the marginal benefits of doing so are quite high. At Qa, it makes sense to allocate more resources to fight pollution. However, as the extent of environmental protection increases, the cheap and easy ways of reducing pollution begin to decrease, and one must use more costly methods. The marginal cost curve rises. Also, as environmental protection increases, one achieves the largest marginal benefits first, followed by reduced marginal benefits. As the quantity of environmental protection increases to, say, Qb, the gap between marginal benefits and marginal costs narrows. At point Qc the marginal costs will exceed the marginal benefits. At this level of environmental protection, society is not allocating resources efficiently, because it is forfeiting too many resources to reduce pollution.
p412.zh: 我们可以利用边际分析工具来说明减少污染的边际成本和边际效益。 如果环境保护的数量低,以致污染范围很广——例如,数量高——通常有许多相对便宜和容易的减少污染的方法,这样做的边际利益相当大。 在Qa,分配更多的资源来防治污染是有意义的。 然而,随着环境保护程度的提高,减少污染的廉价和容易的方法开始减少,必须采用成本更高的方法。边际成本曲线上升. 此外,随着环境保护的加强,人们首先获得最大的边际利益,其次是减少边际利益。 随着环境保护的数量增加到例如Qb,边际利益和边际成本之间的差距缩小. 在Qc点,边际成本将超过边际效益. 在这个环境保护的层次上,社会没有有效地分配资源,因为它浪费了太多的资源,无法减少污染。

p413.original: Marginal Costs and Marginal Benefits of Environmental Protection
p413.zh: 环境保护的边际成本和边际效益

p414.original: As society draws closer to Qb, some might argue that it becomes more important to use market-oriented environmental tools to hold down the costs of reducing pollution. Their objective would be to avoid environmental rules that would provide the quantity of environmental protection at Qc, where marginal costs exceed marginal benefits. The following Clear It Up feature delves into how the EPA measures its policies – and the monetary value of our lives.
p414.zh: 随着社会越来越接近Qb,有些人可能认为,使用面向市场的环境工具来降低减少污染的成本变得更加重要。其目的是避免环境规则在Qc提供环境保护的数量,因为那里的边际成本超过边际效益。 以下的Clearing Up主要探讨环保局如何衡量其政策 — — 以及我们生活的货币价值。

p416.original: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) must estimate the value of saving lives by reducing pollution against the additional costs. In measuring the benefits of government environmental policies, the EPA’s National Center for Environmental Economics (NCEE) values a statistical human life at $7.4 million (in 2006 U.S. dollars, which corresponds to a little more than $10.5 million in February 2022.)
p416.zh: 美国.环境保护局必须通过减少污染和增加成本来估计挽救生命的价值。 在衡量政府环境政策的效益时,环保局的国家环境经济学中心(NCEE)估计人类统计生命值为740万美元(2006年美元,2022年2月相当于1 050多万美元).

p417.original: Economists value a human life on the basis of studies of the value that people actually place on human lives in their own decisions. For example, some jobs have a higher probability of death than others, and these jobs typically pay more to compensate for the risk. Examples are ocean fishery as opposed to fish farming, and ice trucking in Alaska as opposed to truck driving in the “lower forty-eight” states.
p417.zh: 经济学家根据对人们在自己决策中实际赋予人的生命价值的研究,重视人的生命. 例如,一些工作比其他工作死亡的概率更高,而这些工作通常为补偿风险付出更多的报酬.例子有:远洋渔业,而不是养鱼业;阿拉斯加的冰车运输,而不是“48岁以下”州的卡车运输。

p418.original: Government regulators use estimates such as these when deciding what proposed regulations are “reasonable,” which means deciding which proposals have high enough benefits to justify their cost. For example, when the U.S. Department of Transportation makes decisions about what safety systems should be required in cars or airplanes, it will approve rules only where the estimated cost per life saved is $3 million or less.
p418.zh: 政府监管部门在决定拟议条例的“合理性”时使用这种估计数,这意味着决定哪些提议具有足够高的效益来证明它们的费用是合理的。 例如,当美国.运输部将就汽车或飞机需要何种安全系统作出决定,只有在节省的每条生命的估计费用为300万美元或更少的情况下,才批准规则。

p419.original: Resources that we spend on life-saving regulations create a tradeoff. A study by W. Kip Viscusi of Vanderbilt University estimated that when a regulation costs $50 million, it diverts enough spending in the rest of the economy from health care and safety expenditures that it costs a life. This finding suggests that any regulation that costs more than $50 million per life saved actually costs lives, rather than saving them.
p419.zh: 我们花在救生条例上的资源创造了一种取舍。W.的研究.范德比尔特大学的基普·维斯库西(Kip Viscusi)估计,当一项条例花费5 000万美元时,它将经济其余部分的足够支出从它花费生命的保健和安全支出中挪用。 这一调查结果表明,任何每条生命所节省的费用超过5 000万美元的规定,实际上都会造成生命的损失,而不是挽救生命。

p421.original: We can make a strong case, taken as a whole, that the benefits of U.S. environmental regulation have outweighed the costs. As the extent of environment regulation increases, additional expenditures on environmental protection will probably have increasing marginal costs and decreasing marginal benefits. This pattern suggests that the flexibility and cost savings of market-oriented environmental policies will become more important.
p421.zh: 我们可以提出一个强有力的理由,从整体上看,美国环境监管的好处已经超过了成本. 随着环境监管程度的提高,环境保护方面的额外支出可能会增加边际成本和减少边际效益。 这种模式表明,面向市场的环境政策的灵活性和成本节约将变得更加重要。

p504.original: Many countries around the world have become more aware of the benefits of environmental protection. Yet even if most nations individually took steps to address their environmental issues, no nation acting alone can solve certain environmental problems which spill over national borders. No nation by itself can reduce emissions of carbon dioxide and other gases by enough to solve the problem of global warming—not without the cooperation of other nations. Another issue is the challenge of preserving biodiversity, which includes the full spectrum of animal and plant genetic material. Although a nation can protect biodiversity within its own borders, no nation acting alone can protect biodiversity around the world. Global warming and biodiversity are examples of international externalities.
p504.zh: 世界上许多国家已更加认识到环境保护的好处。 然而,即使大多数国家各自采取步骤解决其环境问题,任何国家单独行动都无法解决某些超越国界的环境问题。任何国家本身都无法通过足以解决全球变暖问题的方法——没有其他国家的合作——来减少二氧化碳和其他气体的排放。 另一个问题是保护生物多样性的挑战,它包括各种动植物遗传材料。 虽然一个国家可以保护本国边界内的生物多样性,但没有一个国家能够单独保护世界各地的生物多样性。全球变暖和生物多样性是国际外部因素的例子。

p505.original: Bringing the nations of the world together to address environmental issues requires a difficult set of negotiations between countries with different income levels and different sets of priorities. If nations such as China, India, Brazil, Mexico, and others are developing their economies by burning vast amounts of fossil fuels or by stripping their forest and wildlife habitats, then the world’s high-income countries acting alone will not be able to reduce greenhouse gases. However, low-income countries, with some understandable exasperation, point out that high-income countries do not have much moral standing to lecture them on the necessities of putting environmental protection ahead of economic growth. After all, high-income countries have historically been the primary contributors to greenhouse warming by burning fossil fuels—and still are today. It is hard to tell people who are living in a low-income country, where adequate diet, health care, and education are lacking, that they should sacrifice an improved quality of life for a cleaner environment.
p505.zh: 使世界各国聚集在一起,共同解决环境问题,需要收入水平不同、优先事项不同的国家之间进行一系列艰难的谈判。 如果中国、印度、巴西、墨西哥等国家通过燃烧大量化石燃料或剥离森林和野生生物栖息地来发展经济,那么世界上独自行动的高收入国家将无法减少温室气体。 然而,低收入国家虽然有些令人愤慨,但指出,高收入国家没有多少道德地位来向他们讲解将环境保护置于经济增长之前的必要性。毕竟,高收入国家历来是燃烧化石燃料造成温室变暖的主要原因——今天仍然是。很难告诉生活在低收入国家、缺乏适当饮食、保健和教育的人,他们应该为清洁的环境牺牲改善的生活质量。

p506.original: Can rich and poor countries come together to address global environmental spillovers? At the initiative of the European Union and the most vulnerable developing nations, the Durban climate conference in December 2011 launched negotiations to develop a new international climate change agreement that covers all countries. The outcome of these negotiations was the Paris Climate Agreement, passed in 2015. The Paris Agreement committed participating countries to significant limits on CO2 emissions. To date, 196 entities have signed on, including the two biggest emitters of greenhouse gases—China and the United States.  The U.S. contribution to the agreement was the Clean Power Plan, which planned to reduce power plant CO2 emissions across the U.S. by 17% to pre-2005 levels by 2020, and to further reduce emissions by a cumulative 32% by 2030.  In early 2017, the Trump Administration announced plans to back out of the Paris Climate Agreement. Trump opposed the Clean Power plan, opting instead to shift focus to the use of natural gas. This represented a significant blow to the success of the Paris Agreement. However, on his first day in office, President Biden, on behalf of the United States, rejoined the Paris Climate Agreement.
p506.zh: 富国和穷国能否聚集一堂应对全球环境外溢效应? 在欧洲联盟和最脆弱发展中国家的倡议下,2011年12月德班气候会议发起了谈判,以制定一项涵盖所有国家的国际气候变化新协定。 这些谈判的成果是2015年通过的《巴黎气候协定》。 《巴黎协定》承诺,参加国将大大限制二氧化碳的排放。 迄今为止,已有196个实体签署了协议,其中包括两个最大的温室气体排放国——中国和美国。 美国对协议的贡献是"清洁发电计划",计划到2020年将全美的发电厂二氧化碳排放量降低17%,达到2005年以前的水平,到2030年进一步累计减少32%的排放量.2017年初,特朗普政府宣布计划退出巴黎气候协议.特朗普反对"清洁动力计划",选择将重点转向天然气的使用. 这对《巴黎协定》的成功造成重大打击。 然而,拜登总统在就职的第一天代表美国重新加入了巴黎气候协定.

p513.original: Consider the case of global environmental problems that spill across international borders as a prisoner’s dilemma of the sort studied in Monopolistic Competition and Oligopoly. If one country decides to protect the environment, there is a benefit of 16, but the benefit is divided equally between the two countries. If both countries decide to protect the environment, there is a benefit of 32, which is divided equally between the two countries.

p535.original: The Tradeoff between Economic Output and Environmental Protection
p535.zh: 经济产出与环境保护之间的权衡

p536.original: We can analyze the tradeoff between economic output and the environment with a production possibility frontier (PPF) such as the one in . At one extreme, at a choice like P, a country would be selecting a high level of economic output but very little environmental protection. At the other extreme, at a choice like T, a country would be selecting a high level of environmental protection but little economic output. According to the graph, an increase in environmental protection involves an opportunity cost of less economic output. No matter what their preferences, all societies should wish to avoid choices like M, which are productively inefficient. Efficiency requires that the choice should be on the production possibility frontier.
p536.zh: 我们可以分析经济产出与环境之间的权衡, 并有生产可能性的前沿, 在一种极端情况下,在像P这样的选择中,一个国家将选择高水平的经济产出,但环境保护很少。 在另一个极端,在像T这样的选择中,一个国家将选择高水平的环境保护,但经济产出很少。 根据该图,环境保护的增加涉及经济产出较少的机会成本。 无论偏好如何,所有社会都应该希望避免像M这样的选择,这些选择效率低下。效率要求选择权应放在生产可能性的前沿。

p537.original: The Tradeoff between Economic Output and Environmental Protection
p537.zh: 经济产出与环境保护之间的权衡

p538.original: Economists do not have a great deal to say about the choice between P, Q, R, S and T in , all of which lie along the production possibility frontier. Countries with low per capita gross domestic product (GDP), such as India, place a greater emphasis on economic output—which in turn helps to produce nutrition, shelter, health, education, and desirable consumer goods. Countries with higher income levels, where a greater share of people have access to the basic necessities of life, may be willing to place a relatively greater emphasis on environmental protection.
p538.zh: 经济学家对于P、Q、R、S和T在生产可能性前沿的选择没有太多意见。人均国内生产总值低的国家,如印度,更加重视经济产出,这反过来又有助于生产营养、住房、保健、教育和理想的消费品。收入水平较高的国家如果有更多的人能够获得基本的生活必需品,可能愿意相对更多地强调环境保护。

p539.original: However, economists are united in their belief that an inefficient choice such as M is undesirable. Rather than choosing M, a nation could achieve either greater economic output with the same environmental protection, as at point Q, or greater environmental protection with the same level of output, as at point S. The problem with command-and-control environmental laws is that they sometimes involve a choice like M. Market-oriented environmental tools offer a mechanism for providing either the same environmental protection at lower cost, or providing a greater degree of environmental protection for the same cost.
p539.zh: 然而,经济学家们一致认为,像M这样的低效率的选择是不可取的。一个国家不是选择M,而是可以在Q点相同的环境保护下取得更大的经济产出,也可以在S点相同的产出水平下取得更大的环境保护。指挥与控制环境法的问题在于,它们有时涉及像M这样的选择.面向市场的环境工具提供了一个机制,既可以以较低成本提供同样的环境保护,也可以以同样成本提供更高程度的环境保护。

p541.original: How would an economist respond to claims of environmental damage caused by the Keystone XL project? Furthermore, are these costs “too high” when we measure them against any potential for economic benefit?

p542.original: As this chapter indicates, in deciding whether pipeline construction is a good idea, an economist would want to know not only about the marginal benefits resulting from the additional pipeline construction, but also the potential marginal costs—and especially the pipeline's marginal external costs. Typically these come in the form of environmental impact statements, which are usually required for such projects. For example, an impact statement, released in March 2013 by the Nebraska Department of State, considered the possibility of fewer pipeline miles going over the aquifer system and avoiding completely environmentally fragile areas. It indicated that pipeline construction would not harm "most resources".
p542.zh: 如本章所述,在决定管道建设是否是一个好主意时,经济学家不仅想知道额外管道建设带来的边际效益,而且想知道潜在的边际成本,特别是管道的边际外部成本。通常,这些表格以环境影响说明的形式提出,而这类项目通常需要这种说明。 例如,内布拉斯加州国务院2013年3月发表的一份影响声明考虑了减少含水层系统输油管里程和避免完全环境脆弱地区的可能性。 它表示,管道建设不会损害"大多数资源".

p543.original: As noted at the outset of this chapter, the Obama Administration declined to approve construction of the Keystone XL project. However, the Trump administration announced its willingness to do so, but as noted earlier, the Biden administration effectively ended the project. While we may fairly easily quantify the economic benefits of additional oil in the United States, the social costs are more challenging to measure. Consequently, different observers may reach different conclusions about the balance between estimates of economic benefits and estimates of the social costs of the pipeline project.
p543.zh: 正如本章开头所指出,奥巴马政府拒绝批准建设Keystone XL项目. 然而,特朗普政府宣布愿意这么做,但如前所述,拜登政府实际上结束了该项目. 虽然我们可能相当容易量化美国增加石油的经济效益,但衡量社会成本则更具挑战性。 因此,不同的观察者可能就经济效益估计数与管道项目社会成本估计数之间的平衡得出不同的结论。

p545.original: Depending on their different income levels and political preferences, countries are likely to make different choices about allocative efficiency—that is, the choice between economic output and environmental protection along the production possibility frontier. However, all countries should prefer to make a choice that shows productive efficiency—that is, the choice is somewhere on the production possibility frontier rather than inside it. Revisit Choice in a World of Scarcity for more on these terms.
p545.zh: 根据其不同的收入水平和政治偏好,各国可能就分配效率作出不同的选择,即选择经济产出与环境保护之间的生产可能性边界。 然而,所有国家都应作出显示生产效率的选择,即选择是在生产可能性的前沿,而不是在生产潜力的前沿。重温在恐惧世界中的选择 以更多关于这些条件。

p570.zh: 在T和S之间的选择中,你能说出哪个更好,为什么?

p571.original: If you had to guess, which choice would you think is more likely to represent a command-and-control environmental policy and which choice is more likely to represent a market-oriented environmental policy, choice Q or S? Why?
p571.zh: 如果你不得不猜测,你认为哪种选择更可能代表一种指挥和控制的环境政策,哪种选择更可能代表一种面向市场的环境政策,选择Q还是S? 为什么?

p573.original: Of the choices provided, P, R, and S demonstrate productive efficiency. These are the choices on the production possibility frontier.
p573.zh: 在所提供的选择中,P、R和S显示出生产效率。 这些是生产可能性前沿的选择。

p574.original: Allocative efficiency is determined by the preferences—in this case by the preferences of society as expressed through government and other social institutions. Because you do not have information about these preferences, you really cannot say much about allocative efficiency.
p574.zh: 分配效率由偏好决定——在这种情况下,由通过政府和其他社会机构表达的社会偏好决定。 因为你没有关于这些偏好的信息,你真的不能多说分配效率。

p575.original: In the choice between T and R, R should clearly be preferred, because it has both more corn and more trees. This answer illustrates why productive efficiency is beneficial. Compared with choices inside the PPF, it means more of one or both goods.
p575.zh: 在T和R之间的选择中,R显然应该更受青睐,因为它既拥有更多的玉米,也拥有更多的树木. 这一答案说明了为什么生产效率是有利的。与PPF内部的选择相比,它意味着一种或两种商品的更多.

p576.original: In the choice between T and S, it is not possible to say which choice is better. True, S is on the PPF and T is not—but that only addresses the issue of productive efficiency. If a society has a strong preference for economic output and places a lower value on trees, then allocative efficiency may lead to a choice of T over S. Of course, the reverse could also be true, leading to a choice of S. Without information on society’s preferences to judge allocative efficiency, this question cannot be answered.
p576.zh: 在T和S之间的选择中,无法说哪个选择更好.诚然,S是PPF的,T不是,但只处理生产效率问题。 如果一个社会对经济产出有强烈的偏好,对树木的价值较低,那么分配效率可能导致T胜S的选择. 当然,反之也可能是真实的,导致选择S. 如果没有社会对分配效率的偏好,这个问题就无法回答。

p577.original: Compared with command-and-control policies, market-oriented policies allow either more output with the same environmental protection or more environmental protection with the same level of output—or more of both environmental protection and output. Thus, a choice like Q inside the PPF is more likely to represent a command-and-control policy demand than a choice like S on the frontier of the PPF.
p577.zh: 与指挥和控制政策相比,市场导向政策允许以同样的环境保护进行更多的产出,或以相同的产出水平进行更多的环境保护,或同时进行更多的环境保护和产出。 因此,在PPF内部像Q这样的选择,比起在PPF前沿像S这样的选择,更有可能代表一个指挥与控制的政策需求.

p579.original: In the tradeoff between economic output and environmental protection, what do the combinations on the protection possibility curve represent?
p579.zh: 在经济产出与环境保护之间的权衡中,保护可能性曲线上的组合代表什么?

p580.original: What does a point inside the production possibility frontier represent?
p580.zh: 在生产可能性的前沿内有一个点代表什么?

p582.original: Technological innovations shift the production possibility curve. Look at graph you sketched for . Which types of technologies should a country promote? Should “clean” technologies be promoted over other technologies? Why or why not?
p582.zh: 技术创新改变了生产可能性曲线。看看你画的图一国应推广何种技术?是否应推广“清洁”技术而不是其他技术? 为什么或为什么不呢?

p584.original: In the Land of Purity, there is only one form of pollution, called “gunk.”  shows possible combinations of economic output and reduction of gunk, depending on what kinds of environmental regulations you choose.
p584.zh: 在净土中,只有一种污染形式,叫做“gunk ” 。 它显示经济产出和gunk 减少的可能组合,这取决于你选择何种环境条例。

p603.original: Sketch a graph of a production possibility frontier with environmental quality on the horizontal axis, measured by the percentage reduction of gunk, and with the quantity of economic output on the vertical axis.
p603.zh: 用枪炮减少的百分比和纵向轴上的经济产出数量来衡量,将生产可能性前沿图绘制在水平轴上的环境质量。

p604.original: Which choices display productive efficiency? How can you tell?
p604.zh: 哪些选择显示出生产效率? 你怎么看出来?

p605.original: Which choices show allocative efficiency? How can you tell?
p605.zh: 哪些选择显示分配效率? 你怎么看出来?

p606.original: In the choice between K and L, can you say which one is better and why?
p606.zh: 在K和L之间的选择中,你能说出哪个更好,为什么更好?

p607.original: In the choice between K and N, can you say which one is better, and why?
p607.zh: 在K和N之间的选择中,你能说出哪个更好,为什么?

p608.original: If you had to guess, which choice would you think is more likely to represent a command-and-control environmental policy and which choice is more likely to represent a market-oriented environmental policy, choice L or M? Why?
p608.zh: 如果你不得不猜测,你会认为哪一个选择更可能代表一个指挥和控制的环境政策,哪一个选择更可能代表一个面向市场的环境政策,选择L还是M? 为什么?

c2.original: If the firm takes only its own costs of production into account, then its supply curve will be Sprivate, and the market equilibrium will occur at E0. Accounting for additional external costs of $100 for every unit produced, the firm’s supply curve will be Ssocial. The new equilibrium will occur at E1.
c2.zh: 如果公司只考虑自己的生产成本,那么其供应曲线将是Sprivate,市场平衡发生在E0.公司每生产一个单位,其额外外部费用为100美元,其供应曲线将是Ssocial。新的平衡将在E1发生.

c7.original: If a pollution charge is set equal to $1,000, then the firm will have an incentive to reduce pollution by 30 pounds because the $900 cost of these reductions would be less than the cost of paying the pollution charge.
c7.zh: 如果污染费定为1 000美元,那么公司将受到鼓励,将污染减少30磅,因为减少费用900美元将低于支付污染费的费用。

c12.original: Reducing pollution is costly—one must sacrifice resources. The marginal costs of reducing pollution are generally increasing, because one can first make the least expensive and easiest reductions, leaving the more expensive methods for later. The marginal benefits of reducing pollution are generally declining, because one can take the steps that provide the greatest benefit first, and steps that provide less benefit can wait until later.
c12.zh: 减少污染代价高昂,必须牺牲资源。减少污染的边际成本一般都在增加,因为人们可以首先进行最便宜和最容易的减少,而以后再采取更昂贵的方法。减少污染的边际利益一般都在减少,因为人们可以首先采取提供最大利益的步骤,而提供较少利益的步骤可以等到以后。

c16.original: Each society will have to weigh its own values and decide whether it prefers a choice like P with more economic output and less environmental protection, or a choice like T with more environmental protection and less economic output.
c16.zh: 每个社会都必须权衡自己的价值,决定它是否更喜欢像P这样的选择,经济产出增加,环境保护减少,或者像T这样的选择,环境保护增加,经济产出减少.
